sourceBindings.text: Source A/B questions: which column resembles the unamended low-OM case, why, and what amendment might support aggregation? A illustrates the low-OM concern, but a pure-sand drawing does not measure the stated sandy loam. B is an organic-amended concept, not guaranteed complete retention or blocked pores.

spokenAdaptationChanges.purpose: Exact root-read spoken source completion only. Repair parent bindings describe context; all outside original PCM remains preserved. For new S308 supplement, reading and upfront UI bind the same A/B concept, narrated once without claiming a worked-case solution.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
